checkedAlternates.risk: Marshmallows contain gelatin like gummy bears.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Marshmallows are whipped into an aerated sugar-foam (group-2), whereas gummy bears are dense unwhipped gelatin gels (group-1).

checkedAlternates.risk: Nougat contains roasted almonds or pistachios.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Nougat’s base is whipped egg-white honey foam (group-2), not ground nut-and-sugar paste (group-3).
